# Indian Mental Health

> A peer-reviewed academic journal publishing interdisciplinary mental health research with international indexing and open access.

The Indian Journal of Mental Health is an indexed academic publication serving the Indian subcontinent and global research community. It maintains rigorous peer-review standards, ethical guidelines, and manuscript submission processes for mental health and related scientific research.

## Key Topics

- Indian Journal of Mental Health
- peer-reviewed research

- manuscript submission

- [Open Access Policy](https://indianmentalhealth.com/open-access-policy.html): Open access publishing and copyright licensing policy
